# Swiftdrop

A courier app for local shops. A shop creates a delivery with a pickup address, a drop-off address, the customer's
name and phone, and the parcel size. Drivers who are online see new delivery offers with the fee and accept one; only
one driver can take each offer and a driver carries one delivery at a time. The driver follows the steps: going to
pickup, picked up, going to drop-off, delivered with a photo of the parcel at the door. The customer can follow their
delivery's progress. Drivers see what they earned today and this week. Dispatchers see every delivery by status and
which drivers are online.

Look: practical and fast to use on a phone, high contrast, a bright orange accent.
